'''Fainar's Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Owned by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Fainar]], the cantina was renowned as one of the safest underworld retreats in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] due to the planet's government's propensity for taking bribes and Fainar's [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]] that let her detect any [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] or [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who were attempting to listen in on her patrons' thoughts. The cantina also boasted a significant amount of electronic countermeasures in order to ensure its customers' complete privacy.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fainar's Cantina was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', published by [[Dorling Kindersley]] as a tie-in to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
